summary: Chelan County lookout: L-4 cab built 1931 on a 40-ft timber tower, abandoned in the 1950s; gone, with footings reported on a 2015 visit.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a 40-foot timber tower
facts.status_note: No tower remains; cement footings and other remnants were reported on a 2015 visit

staffing.status: Charles G. Brown listed as known lookout personnel; no dates given

visit.trail_note: About a mile from Scottish Lakes High Camp; an easy hike or snowshoe. The old spur trail is difficult to find.

events.note: L-4 cab built in 1931 (register, Firelookout.com, Willhite Web); Willhite Web describes a 40 foot tower

Chiwaukum Creek Fire burned over the ridge after the lookout was gone

Registered April 13, 2020; nominated by Tammy McLeod

notes_for_editor: Built year and abandonment agree across the register, Firelookout.com and Willhite Web. The 40 ft tower height and the 2014 fire detail rest on Willhite Web alone; the register and Firelookout.com give no tower height, so the height_m correction is single-sourced. Staffing is one name with no dates. Access rests on Willhite Web alone (best start at Scottish Lakes High Camp, easy hike or snowshoe, old spur trail hard to find); the story still tells the reader to check with the Forest Service. The 1950 abandoned event is a decade placeholder, not a date.
